description: Everything needed to add one component, fast: one shell command that installs its npm packages and downloads it as a single self contained .tsx file (animated icons and the cn() helper inside), plus a usage example and the props. Run the command rather than writing the file out. Pass files "single" only if you cannot run shell commands.

files.description: "none" (default) gives a command that downloads the file; "single" includes the file's contents, for agents without a shell
